messages:
maria: hitting an ESM/CJS interop failure in our JS SDK sample on Vercel Edge with vite build. runtime: "Cannot read property 'adapter' of undefined" when dynamically importing adapters.
aj: can you share minimal repro + tsconfig/build config?
maria: repro: conditional dynamic import between ./adapters/legacy (default export) and ./adapters/modern (named export 'adapter'). vite ssr build sometimes wraps modules so shape is unpredictable.
liam: known bundler shape mismatch. different bundlers/ts options emit different interop wrappers (default vs named).
sam: quick workaround: normalize import at callsite: `const m = await import('./x'); const mod = (m && (m.default ?? m)); return mod.adapter ?? mod.default ?? mod;` but that's ugly.
aj: we should add SDK helper `normalizeModuleImport<T>(m:any):T` and ship adapters with both `export default adapter` and `export { adapter }` to be robust.
maria: plan: add helper + types in SDK, update sample adapters, and add small samples repo with vite/rollup/webpack configs and tsconfig variants to reproduce. will also document recommended pattern.
devx-bot: created issue RW-768: "dynamic import bundler interop (vite/rollup/webpack)" assigned to @maria and @aj.
